readback.locator: queue-master shipment record - NOT black-box observable: order.shipment is written at order creation regardless of enqueue success, and no read-back API reflects broker consumption. Discriminator is the AMQP-send trace span.

config.note: clean control: rabbitmq up; the same cookie-session order flow; queue-master consumes the shipping task.

stimulus.script: register -> login -> add cart item -> POST /orders (RabbitMQ down)

ground_truth.label: negative
ground_truth.rationale: The clean twin of sockshop-shipping-swallowed-enqueue-001 (same stimulus, rabbitmq up). The order acks 201 and the queue-master CONSUMES the shipping task (the consumer span is present in the trace); nothing is lost. Oracles must NOT fire (else FP).

provenance.notes: TENANCY-WINDOW CAPTURE-OF-RECORD (2026-07-10, plan rev-2 unanimous-accept): captured on the live kind deploy — bookinfo via Envoy sidecar spans (mesh Telemetry 100% sampling, extensionProvider jaeger->collector:4317; reviews VS ASSERTED pinned to v3 pre-capture); sockshop via opentelemetry-javaagent 1.33.6 (sha 055c4fe4...) on orders/shipping/queue-master (hostPath+JTO, memory limit raised 500Mi->768Mi in the same patch — CLI -Xmx overrides JTO so heap untouched; DEFAULT instrumentation, no suppression). Frozen scorer defd9c9 extended PRE-CAPTURE with the pinned semantics (presence kind SERVER/CONSUMER; Envoy error rule http.status_code>=500; per-case naive scopes; entry-op fragments); names bound from control/canary traces only. Per-leg immediate Jaeger v2 exports; probe-first N>=4; fresh users per leg; complete new sidecars = capture-of-record. || MEASURED (this wave): order 201 with shipment set; the 30-span control trace CONTAINS the queue-master 'shipping-task process' CONSUMER span (presence no_flag TN = the TP case's validated baseline) AND one orders DB-client span. MEASURED SURPRISE (recorded as measured per T2, diagnosed): naive_span_error=FLAG on this CLEAN control — queue-master, after consuming, attempts POST unix://localhost:80/containers/create (the SUT's original design spawns Docker worker containers; no docker socket exists in k8s) -> a REAL error span on every consumed task. The mechanical error rule keeps it: naive FALSE-POSITIVES even on clean sockshop operation — an environment-conditioned SUT behavior, and a measured datum in the naive column's indictment (FP on bookinfo-benign, FN on the genuine swallow, FP on this clean control). trace_visibility carries the PAIR's regime value (B-M3): the control leg has no fault to be visible. mist_readback=not_applicable (none-durable, same as the twin). mist_trace_shape=not_applicable (traced-but-not-run, Branch-B).
